about.heading: About FixPoint Garage
about.story: FixPoint Garage has been serving the local community with honest, reliable automotive repair for years. Our certified technicians combine hands-on experience with modern diagnostic tools to keep your vehicle running safely and smoothly.

services.title: Engine Repair
services.shortDesc: Complete diagnostics and repair for all engine issues.
services.fullDesc: Our engine repair service covers everything from minor tune-ups to full engine overhauls, using precise diagnostic equipment to identify the root cause before any work begins.

services.title: Brake Repair
services.shortDesc: Pad, rotor, and full brake system service.
services.fullDesc: We inspect, repair, and replace brake pads, rotors, and lines to keep your stopping power reliable in every condition.

services.title: Oil Change
services.shortDesc: Fast, thorough oil and filter service.
services.fullDesc: Regular oil changes with premium filters keep your engine lubricated and extend its lifespan. Quick turnaround, done right.

services.title: Car AC Service
services.fullDesc: Beat the heat with a fully serviced AC system — we check refrigerant levels, compressors, and cooling performance.

services.title: Battery Service
services.fullDesc: We test your battery's health and charging system, and replace it on the spot if needed to avoid unexpected breakdowns.

services.title: Tire Service
services.fullDesc: From new tire fitting to balancing and alignment, we make sure your ride is smooth, safe, and even on the road.

services.title: Computer Diagnostics
services.shortDesc: Full vehicle scan with modern diagnostic tools.
services.fullDesc: Our OBD diagnostic scanners quickly identify error codes and underlying issues so repairs are accurate the first time.

services.title: Transmission Repair
services.fullDesc: Transmission problems handled with care — fluid service, repairs, and full rebuilds for manual and automatic systems.

faq.question: Do I need to book an appointment in advance?
faq.answer: Walk-ins are welcome, but booking ahead through our website or WhatsApp guarantees you a faster turnaround.

faq.question: Do you offer any warranty on repairs?
faq.answer: Yes, most repairs come with a 30-90 day warranty depending on the service performed.

faq.question: Which car brands do you service?
faq.answer: We service all major local and imported brands including Toyota, Honda, Suzuki, and Hyundai.

faq.question: Can I get a free estimate before repair?
faq.answer: Yes, our technicians will run a diagnostic and give you a clear estimate before any work begins.
